description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring an Application Developer specializing in open source to develop, support, and maintain client applications. The role analyzes and resolves technical issues, collaborates with cross-functional teams, and provides client guidance on implementing, customizing, and integrating open source platforms.
Application Developer building, maintaining, and troubleshooting open-source applications using Python, Node.js, and Django

Responsibilities:
• Develop and Maintain Applications: Develop, support, and maintain applications using open source development platforms such as C, C++, Perl, Python, Node JS, and Django, ensuring high-quality solutions that meet client needs
• Analyze and Resolve Issues: Utilize expertise in open source technologies to analyze and resolve issues, providing timely and effective solutions to ensure minimal disruption to clients
• Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions, providing technical guidance and support to ensure successful project outcomes
• Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients on open source platform implementation, customization, and integration, ensuring seamless adoption and optimal usage
• Implement Solutions: Implement solutions that meet client needs, leveraging expertise in open source technologies to deliver high-quality results

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Exposure to developing, supporting, and maintaining applications using open source development platforms such as C, C++, Perl, Python, Node JS, and Django
• Experience working with open source technologies to analyze and resolve issues, providing timely and effective solutions
• Exposure to collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions, providing technical guidance and support
• Experience working with clients to provide technical guidance and support on open source platform implementation, customization, and integration
• Exposure to implementing solutions that meet client needs, leveraging expertise in open source technologies to deliver high-quality results
• you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Exposure to various open source development frameworks, including C, C++, Perl, Python, Node JS, and Django, to stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
• Experience with complex issue analysis and resolution using open source technologies to provide timely and effective solutions
• Exposure to integrating multiple open source platforms to design and implement comprehensive solutions
• Hadoop, Databricks
